NARRATOR.role: Warm, gentle storyteller who reads the book aloud.

voice.hint: warm calm male storyteller, friendly, audiobook narration

PETUNIA.role: The little girl the book is about. Lives with endometriosis pain in her tummy; brave, curious, honest about how she feels.
PETUNIA.look: Exactly as drawn in bible/characters/PETUNIA/reference.png and bible/sheets/PETUNIA_sheet.png: curly brown pigtails with magenta ties, freckles, gap tooth, magenta/lavender overalls with teal pocket, yellow tee, yellow socks, plum sneakers.

FRIEND.role: This episode's guest Endo Warrior: a new friend in every episode who also lives with endo (or supports someone who does) and shares one brave trick for handling it. Kind, funny, believes Petunia right away.
FRIEND.look: Changes every episode: put this episode's guest drawing in bible/characters/FRIEND/reference.png.

MOM.role: Petunia's mom. Calm, loving, listens and takes her seriously.
MOM.look: Exactly as drawn in bible/characters/MOM/reference.png: curly shoulder-length hair, gold hoops, freckles, plum cardigan, dark jeans cuffed, yellow socks, cream sneakers.

DAD.role: Petunia's dad. Big-hearted, playful, brings fruit bowls and the heating pad, always makes her laugh.
DAD.look: Exactly as drawn in bible/characters/DAD/reference.png: short curly hair, beard, olive shirt-jacket over cream tee, dark jeans cuffed, mustard sneakers.

DR-SALEM.role: Petunia's doctor. Kind, curious, explains endometriosis simply with picture books and listens carefully.
DR-SALEM.look: Exactly as drawn in bible/characters/DR-SALEM/reference.png: long wavy dark hair with a silver streak, round glasses, cream lab coat, teal blouse, charcoal trousers, plum shoes.

NURSE-MINDY.role: Cheerful hospital nurse who gets Petunia ready for surgery: explains each step, the comfy gown and grippy socks, and makes the countdown feel like a game.
NURSE-MINDY.look: Put her sheet in bible/sheets/ and reference in bible/characters/NURSE-MINDY/reference.png.

ENDO-MONSTER.role: The sneaky, mischievous Endo-Monster who lives in Petunia's tummy. He sneaks in, peeks around corners, and tries to spoil fun with tummy twists, then gets foiled when Petunia and her friends speak up and use their brave tricks. Silly-sneaky, never truly frightening; kids can spot him before the characters do.
ENDO-MONSTER.look: Exactly as drawn in bible/characters/ENDO-MONSTER/reference.png (book painting style, NOT the 3D sheet): furry, left half red, right half purple, big droopy ears, small horns, orange eyes, fangs, claws.

voice.hint: grumbly gravelly cartoon monster, funny, raspy
